description: Which payment methods work in a country today and how reliably: for every method class (cards, bank transfers, instant transfers, e-wallets, mobile money, cash, crypto, direct local rails) and direction (pay-ins, payouts) a status — healthy / degraded / outage / no_data — with the time it began and a ready citation. Free level: the free currencies, one day behind. Pro keys of the Rail Health Index: today, every currency, the health index (100 = the rail's own norm), availability, supply.
